name: refactor_ruby_extract_validation_module
description: Extracts duplicated name-validation from two Ruby form classes into a shared mixin module, preserving behavior
prompts: lib/signup_form.rb and lib/profile_form.rb contain the same inline name validation (strip the value, then require it be non-empty AND at least 2 characters). Refactor to remove the duplication: create lib/validations.rb defining a module App::Validations with an instance method valid_name?(value) implementing exactly that rule, and have both form classes `include` it and call valid_name? instead of their inline copy. Do not change observable behavior - a 2-character name like "Al" must still be accepted and the returned strings ("signed_up:...", "saved:...", "invalid") must be unchanged. Neither form should still contain the inline `name.length < 2` check.

setup_files.lib/signup_form.rb:
module App
  class SignupForm
    def initialize(name)
      @name = name
    end

    def submit
      # inline validation (duplicated in ProfileForm)
      name = @name.to_s.strip
      return "invalid" if name.empty? || name.length < 2
      "signed_up:#{name.downcase}"
    end
  end
end

test_setup_files.test/refactor_test.rb:
require "minitest/autorun"
require_relative "../lib/signup_form"
require_relative "../lib/profile_form"

class RefactorHiddenTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_signup_accepts_two_char_name
    assert_equal "signed_up:jo", App::SignupForm.new(" Jo ").submit
  end

  def test_signup_rejects_single_char
    assert_equal "invalid", App::SignupForm.new("x").submit
  end

  def test_profile_accepts_two_char_name
    assert_equal "saved:al", App::ProfileForm.new("Al").save
  end

  def test_profile_rejects_blank
    assert_equal "invalid", App::ProfileForm.new("   ").save
  end
end

reference_solution.lib/validations.rb:
module App
  module Validations
    # Extracted shared rule: a name is valid when, after stripping, it is
    # non-empty and at least 2 characters long.
    def valid_name?(value)
      name = value.to_s.strip
      !name.empty? && name.length >= 2
    end
  end
end
